foodMatrices.name: Low-Acid Beef & Vegetable Stew in Savory Gravy (1.2% NaCl, High Ionic Loss)
foodMatrices.description: Classic low-acid shelf-stable ready-to-eat entree. Moderate-to-high ionic conductivity drives significant microwave energy absorption in the liquid phase, requiring careful water immersion velocity to avoid boiling boundary layers.

foodMatrices.name: Homogeneous Mashed Potato Puree with Butter & Cream (0.8% NaCl, Moderate Loss)
foodMatrices.description: Dense carbohydrate and dairy suspension. High moisture content promotes deep penetration depth at 915 MHz, enabling rapid core heating without overcooking outer surfaces if overpressure is maintained.

foodMatrices.name: Wild Salmon Fillet in Light Sea Salt Brine (1.8% NaCl, Severe Edge Focusing)
foodMatrices.description: High-salinity marine protein. High dissolved ionic content produces high dielectric loss factor (ε'' = 44.5), dramatically increasing electric field corner intensification and thermal inversion hot spots along package edges.

foodMatrices.name: Spiced Lentil & Garbanzo Bean Curry (1.4% NaCl, Particulate Attenuation)
foodMatrices.description: Heterogeneous particulate suspension. Differential heating between starch-rich pulses and seasoned sauce matrix requires continuous water circulation to equalize surface temperature and preserve texture.
